rappel_detail.anchor: no fixed anchors: build off a rock horn, or leave a picket or screw
rappel_detail.station: Near the top of the couloir line.
rappel_detail.notes: Rappel 1 of 2, on two 60 m ropes.

rappel_detail.anchor: no fixed anchors: build off a rock horn, or leave a picket or screw
rappel_detail.station: The col southeast of the summit.
rappel_detail.notes: Rappel 2 of 2, down from the col; a single 60 m rope reaches. Then descend south-side snow and reverse the Green Creek approach.

set.rappel_count_note: Two rappels, from one winter party's account: a double-rope rappel near the top of the line, and a single-rope rappel from the col southeast of the summit. Bring cord and tat; nothing is fixed.
